implementation_changes.w15_dependency_restrictions: AdoptionController.is_current now checks active correction restrictions on the exact subject, Review and every required input/evidence version, passing the candidate recovery decision ID so only the exact recovered scope can clear a restriction.
implementation_changes.test_correction_fixture: The W34 recovery fixture now replaces the superseded Review in the new evidence set instead of retaining it alongside the new Review.

positive_checks.propagation: A correction in the Evidence used by the W36 deep chain reaches ResearchRevision, AdvisorOutput, TeacherOutput, ConditionalOutput, ReviewCase, Review, Article and Edition through explicit Archive references.
positive_checks.historical: The old Article body remains available through KNOWN_TO_SYSTEM_AS_OF.
positive_checks.scoped_recovery: A recovery Review binding the exact target and correction case may create a candidate W15 decision; only the recovered scope and decision ID can release the target restriction.

negative_checks.current_body: CURRENT Article and Edition queries under the affected review scope withhold their bodies.
negative_checks.old_pass: The old W15 adoption is not current after the correction.
negative_checks.new_edition: W32 cannot recompose the old edition; it stops at the superseded W23 Evidence/current-adoption boundary.
negative_checks.partial_recovery: Article-only recovery remains non-current while M10/M11/M12 or other required inputs stay restricted.

controlled_binding_refresh.reason: The W40 test registration and shared W15 implementation summary changed the conservative managed-file and design binding contexts. All 21/59 bindings were explicitly reviewed; no W/G progress or evidence was reset.

limits: The correction is an explicitly marked owned test copy, not a naturally occurring correction.
The recovery Review is a bounded integration fixture; full W31 semantic review of the corrected mature content remains unverified.
No real cross-week archive, external source withdrawal, user reading or production backup was used.
W40 remains IN_PROGRESS and does not close G02.
